market_question: Will the Republicans win the Maine Senate race in 2026?
reasoning: Moderate Republican Susan Collins easily won re-election in Maine in both 2014 and 2020, even with a Democratic presidential win. She is a strong incumbent, likely to run again at age 74, giving Republicans a solid chance to hold the seat. Even if she retires, the GOP has a path, but her incumbency alone pushes the true probability well above the market's 22.5%.
evidence_points: Collins won in 2020 by 8 points despite Biden carrying Maine by 9 points; she has high cross-party appeal.
Incumbent senators of any party who run for re-election in states with partisan lean typically win over 70% of the time.
Maine has a history of electing moderate Republican senators (Collins, Snowe) in statewide races.
sources_consulted: Historical election results (2020 ME Senate race)
Incumbent re-election rates in recent Senate cycles
